_comment: ngsolve hdivdiv#0 (HDivDiv is nn-conforming, weaker than H2). Verified 2026-08-03 on NGSolve 6.2.2604. Pins the continuity STRUCTURE of the space with exact facet-jump quadratic forms on a fixed pseudo-random member: HDivDiv rel nn jump ~1e-17 and rel tt jump ~2.3; MatrixValued(H1,symmetric) has BOTH jumps exactly 0. Triggers both wrong variants: literal VectorH1 moments raise NgException 'Trace of non-matrix called', and the fully continuous MatrixValued(H1) moment space assembles but the HHJ deflection blows past 1e6 (~1.8e14) instead of being 'off by a factor 1.1-1.5'. Correct HDivDiv + M_nn Dirichlet reproduces the Navier SS value 0.00406235 q L^4/D to <2%.
